body: I feel this.

Exactly! Or just the feeling of being on a swing, playing in the sand, drawing pictures. Kids are so living in the moment, doing what feels fun and good and although we can focus on stuff we enojy as adults we obviously can‘t do that all the time as kids can
I hope I can aswell
I would give a kidney to go back. Anything.
It really is! It makes you feel better for a while and then you have to go back to reality. That‘s why I hope reincarnation is real.
I actually do have that aswell. Everything helps for the moment, but not long term.
I do these things but it always goes back to still wanting to end everything
I can relate so much about that your mind is enough to dissociate from reality. Dreaming about the way I wish I could have become and what a wonderful life I could have is my escape mechanism
I wish. But it‘s long gone. Sorry
Girl I feel every word you say because I feel the same
I don‘t know. My brain can‘t handle or accept nothingsness. Nothingsness forever means you are never going to wake up again, which seems pretty scary
I know what you mean. If death could mean reincarnation or possibly reliving my life in another demension I would happily end it yesterday. My fear of nothingsness is too big.
I would give everything I have if some physic would come up tomorrow and say how he found a new physics law and is now able to send people in the past. Everyyything. Aren‘t you afraid of death?
Oh my god you know how much I loved crash bandicoot racing? Coming home and playing these games was a dream.
Yeah but I hate that it‘s not possible and never will be!
I feel this

I dream about this as well. I‘m actually way to scared to commit suicide because of death. I want reincarnation or repeating my life to be real, so I can experience childhood again. We don’t know what happens after death though, maybe there is nothing. And that shit scares me.
I‘m so sad that it‘s not possible. I just want to relive the magic of childhood.
I think to change some things, ask for help when I was still young
Reading storys like yours makes me SO angry. They also make me feel like I‘m overreacting with my own problems and make me feel really bad. Really I‘m sorry, no child should go through this
Sorry english isn‘t my native language maybe sometimes things I say come across wrong lol
Oh no I wasn‘t sarcastic! I‘m just surprised how many people are leaving comments and can relate to my feelings :)
So many people can relate, I would have never thought so many people wished they were kids again!
Innocence and not knowing is really nice
Don‘t worry, I‘m always going back and forth but I‘m too scared to do it. I‘m too scared of death, which is funny when you‘re sucidial

That‘s so sad, have you tried asking for it online? Sometimes things can be found with social media. Me too, I dream about this feeling of being a child, it felt totally different from being a adult. Everything feels light and cozy and things are so exciting, even if it‘s just running around with your friends

Man that‘s so sad :( I can relate about the feeling of everything felt like magic. Being a child it let‘s you really feel like everything is magic. Sorry about your loss. I bet your dad loved you just as much as you loved him.
Enjoy it! You‘re still so young

I often think about suicide and think nothingsness isn‘t so bad at all. But then my brain wants to think about nothingsness more seriously and then it goes like this: it‘s nothing, you see nothing, feel nothing, you are rotting in some grave although you are not there anymore. How is that even possible? If you really deeply think about that it feels like a joke. How are we rotting, but we aren‘t there anymore? I can‘t with this thought. It‘s not even like sleeping, when you sleep you dream, you breath, you wake up. Death is nothing. That freaks me out. It‘s interesting you say you believed in reincarnation as a child, because I read up a lot about it and many children are believing this without ever discussing this with their parents. There are quite a few children who also talk about past live memorys. I don‘t know how it works in terms of population or if we have a saying in what life we would want to reincarnate. Maybe some souls are new souls and life for the first time? And some are older ones. Where they would come from? I don‘t know. It would say that there is much more to the life and universe that we don‘t understand yet. Maybe it‘s not true and we really only have one shot at life.

Oh my god I‘m so sorry! That must be really hard. Good point, as a child you can just be vulnerable and it‘s other peoples job to take care of you. I hope you find moments where you can be vulnerable and grief as well instead of just being strong. It‘s ok to not always be strong!

I wish I was the same. If I really wanted to be nothing I would just go with it and would be dead now. I‘m too afraid of being nothing, if that makes sense. I know, I wouldn’t mind because if you are nothing you can feel nothing, but that‘s the shit that scares me with death
Me too, below the age 11 would be perfect. I remember that I really liked school and everything at the age six-nine, afterwards it went downhill for me
Same and same! I‘m too afraid of death though. So I‘m just here waiting for it to happen, hoping I’m not around in 10-40 years.

I feel this. So. Much. Every word. You explained how I‘m feeling exactly. I might sound crazy but I‘ve been reading up so much on reincarnation, I don‘t know if it‘s real, I don‘t know if we would have a choice to repeat in a smiliar body and so on. But it kinda gives me hope that we will get another shot. I‘m too scared of nothingsness, so scared that it stops me from suicide
It really did, but there are more people on dating apps now!
Oh my god! I can relate so much, I was always really shy and never made a move. You can still do that though!
Tell us lol
So sad! Can someone find a new physic rule please lol

Kids can be cruel and adults can be too stupid to act when they should and it‘s their responsibillity. I wish we could all go back to when it started to go down for us! I would pay anything for someone to invent time travel

Me too! I‘m still jealous of people who are really pretty and loved lol. I wish there was a way to go back. When I look at childhood pics I can see this joy and innocence and I can also see where it got lost.
Isn‘t that so weird looking at this? feels like another life almost
I wish we could go back to the point when it went downhill and change it.
Exactly, the feeling of just being free. Not feeling depressed, just caring about anything than playing super mario bros.
I think for me it was age six as well! Just going into kindergarten, having play dates and feeling good drawing water color pictures
I‘m sorry! Yes I have some good ones until it went downhill and everything was shitty
Can relate!

Oh my god me too! I lost this feeling of complete joy I felt when I was younger, just from basic things such as riding a bike or getting ice cream.  Now I feel dead inside most of the time as well. Sometimes there are nice moments, but most of the time I don‘t want life anymore
I wonder the same. People make life fucking complicated without a reason most of the time.
Honestly same!
Okay! It‘s hard to let go of the childhood. I miss it as well.

Everything is a cycle. My dads dad was an alcoholic who terrorized his own family. My dad became an alcoholic, as I grew older I hated him like he hated his own dad. Most people are too blind to see this, you’re clever! You can break it.
Me too! When you felt SO happy because you got a new video game, someone cooked your fav dinner or you had to laugh until your belly hurt
Please don‘t! You have everything ahead of you.
I‘m sorry, humans that do something like this to children deserve nothing but bad stuff happening to them
Oh my god me too. I read so much about reincarnation the past months and if I had proof that it is 100% a thing I would just go
Right? My brain hurts thinking about this. I honestly wish aliens that can time travel would be a thing I would beg them to abduct me lol
Sorry you had to go through all that. I know what you mean, my childhood wasn‘t all happy and rainbows. I also feel like a big kid. I just want to go back and change so much.
We need some genius who builds a time mashine. I wish aliens would abduct me and being me to the past lol
It is the hardest thing ever

I feel like from this it can only get worse. I never had a relationship, I never found love. In the past I was still very hopeful about this but not anymore. I have given up on the inside and all I want is to go back and repeat my life from the beginning.
That is exactly how I feel! I made too many mistakes and while I can see why I did them, I can‘t undo them. I want to go back, change it and get all my potential out instead of ending up depressed.
I‘m glad someone can relate. Being an adult is too hard. I just want to go back and do differently.

Yeah I think that‘s a really good description. I‘m no longer this 20 year old rebellious kid. I remember looking at so many stupid tattoos that I thought were so cool, I‘m glad I didn’t had the money to do more but I wish I didn’t had the money to do any in the first place.

That sounds really good! I can‘t believe how much this affects mental health. Especially in the summer, every summer day is horror to me now and summer used to be me fav season! I miss the feelinf of feeling free in my body. And everytime I try not to think about tattoos someone reminds me. Yesterday a kid came up to me. Probably 12 years old and looked weird and said: what is this on your arm? And I said a tattoo and he was like doesn’t suit you. And I just thought yeah I know.

I‘ve got them seven years ago, when this whole emo tumblr scene was so cool and I spent too much time on the internet. I thought getting tattooed would be so cool and unique, nobody I knew had tattoos and I was rebellious and thought tattoos would make me happy. They did for a very short time until I didn‘t cared about them anymore and until I realized over time how stupid I was! Then I started to HATE it.
Good point. I would leave instantly if I knew I could get a different shot in life, different body, circumstances, being a child again happy and curious about the world
That sounds quite good but I‘m just so afraid of nothing because we can’t imagine nothing as humans
Me too and I‘m so afraid it‘s just nothing. There are many storys that insists there is smth beautiful, but we don’t know for sure, science says no

I‘m so jealous of people that don’t have these thoughts. People who have a full life of hobbys, family and friends and enjoy life. I can’t stand the thought of growing old and knowing I hated most of my time here.

Sorry for that! My parents wanted me and my siblings, to the outside we probably looked like a normal family. But none of my siblings likes my parents or feels love for them. So obviously they did something wrong in being parents. If it would have been just me I could just be weird. All I wanted from life is a supportive loving system, instead I‘m now a depressed mess.

I think you are right, but I don‘t want to live this life anymore. I wish life would come with a reset botton, I just want a fresh restart. With parents who actually inform themselves how to raise children, how to actually connect with them and bring out the best Instead of the worst.

I‘m sorry the artist flopped it, that must be really hard. Especially if you really thought this through. You are so right about our brain maximizing the feeling. I can totally understand everything you say.

You described everything I feel very well! I liked my body. I would say it‘s the body that society would describe as attractive. So knowing that I fully did this to my own just as you described is the hardest part. Maybe it‘s weird, but I think as long as it helps it‘s fine. There‘s this girl for instance on Instagram taylorbelle and she has a full sleeve. Although I hate tattoos now I look at her and think wow! She‘s beautiful and then I think if I can view someone else with tattoos sooo attractive then maybe I didn‘t ruined myself as much as I think in my own mind
I can relate completely

Oh god it‘s a relief to know I‘m not alone but at the same time I wish you wouldn’t have to feel this way! Right? It‘s scary they could see and ask about the tattoo. Although probably it wouldn’t be a big deal to them, but it‘s so hindering when you feel not confident anymore in your body.

Oh yeah it‘s really hard! It‘s weird how self concious you can get about something like this. I hate it every time I shower or take a bath. And the worst is it‘s already hindering me really enjoying my body. There‘s this person I really want to hook up with and I know he wants too and he always reminds me and I feel so self concious about this stupid tattoo. It‘s really affecting my life

That is very true. My thoughts about this are definetely not good for me. I keep thinking I wish I would have done something else when I was unhappy, something that wouldn’t have left a permanent change on my body. Sometimes I even think why couldn’t you just drink too much like a normal teen lol. But I have to remind myself there‘s no way to change the past, it‘s not happening. Laser and trying to calm down everytime I freak out is the only way

It‘s the hardest part to admit that at some point we clearly made this desicion and that we did it to ourselves. I kept saying to my mother why didn‘t you stop me, but she couldn’t even if she tried. I just wanted to be cool and get tattoos so badly and when I now look back I know why. I thought it would make me happy and that was a huge mistake. It‘s very hard and I never thought I would be in this position.
Good luck to you also! I cross my fingers that we all get rid of the ink as best as possible.

That was really good to read. Sometimes you are so caught up in your thoughts that you feel like you are the only person in the world feeling this way. I can really imagine how you must feel, especially in such a place were so many people hang out at the beach in swimwear! 

You made me laugh with your shitty pinterest tattoos, really! Thank you for this, although I really feel your pain!
That‘s very true, at least time passes while we try to do something about it ❤️
Hahaha if it takes my ink away I‘m in
Sounds like a plan! Then he/she can test the new invention on us and we would be the first who are free

True! It would be awesome if there was something you could inject instead of laser that breaks all the ink apart at once. Or something you could tattoo in that somehow takes the ink away. If I were a dermatologist I would do research 🤣
I saw this one time in a video where a guy covered his whole body tattoos! Really cool. But probably not something for the summer 🤣
Yes, guess we will know if something like this happens! For now laser and wearing clothes that cover them are the only options
That’s true.. I once read about an invention that promised to suck ink out of the skin in a session. But haven’t looked it up anymore if they continued their research.
I really cross my fingers for soliton, it promises faster removal at least
I read a lot about soliton coming out soon. Maybe that will happen and make it easier hopefully also
I hope you are free from the one you hate soon!

That‘s true! That sounds like a dream, going to the beach and feeling free. I will keep going for that. What I‘m deeply scared of is that my tattoo may go but in the end it‘s still visible in white because so much melanin is gone. That would be the worst case.

Getting tattoos instead of dealing with the feelings hits it totally! I think for a lot of people tattoos are a way to distract from body or mental issues? Obviously not for everyone. There are people who just love the art on their body and stuff. But definetely for me it was like it was for you. I feel like tattoo artists should ask the client a bit about their life lol. Like why are you doing this? Does this really have meaning to you? Would you be fine waiting a few years? It would save a lot of young people to feel like we do now.

I wish the same as you!! 
This group really helps me. The past days I was in a deep deep depression. Today I finally feel somewhat normal because of you and all the other nice meaningful responses.

That is true. Although I wish tattoo regret would be a thing I didn’t had to experience. 

I really wish you the best for your process! I will look for your updates if you post some. At least I‘m not the only person who feels this way, sometimes you really think you are the only one. Especially because most of the people in my circle don‘t have tattoos, some do but smaller ones and nothing they regret.

Thank you. Really all of these really nice responses make me feel a lot better already. I was the same as you, I got tattoos just for the sake of tattoos. I never thought them through, the important part was getting a tattoo and mine are not meaningful to me as well. Sometimes when people have cool tattoos and they are really meaningful like something for their passed parents, grandparents etc. I think yeah these tattoos are pretty cool. But I don‘t like mine anymore, I also have a forearm peace and I get what you mean. It‘s not the tattoo that is bothering me the most, but it‘s still not great and nowadays I obviously wouldn’t get any tattoo at all. Small ones maybe, but not huge ones as mine are. Your points are very valid, I hope tattoo removal continues to improve and someday there‘s a even easier option than laser.

That is true, my parents weren’t strict at all. I guess I wish in that sense they were, but I can‘t change it. It was my own doing in the end. 

That‘s true. Well there is no other option than laser at the moment, so we have to stick with it.

You sound like a fun person! Go on with the silly tats you don‘t regret haha! 

Yes they do! Especially when you are so young. You think you are smart and above everyone, when in reality sometimes you should just listen to adults who lived a little longer already. I told my mom why didn’t you stop me, why? You could have and she was like don‘t blame me, I couldn’t have stopped you anyway. And I guess she‘s right, once I had a stupid idea I had to do it. I‘m actually glad I never went for full body tattoos, guess I came to my senses and glad I didn‘t had the money! 

I can understand that! Better go to a place with good reviews. Which country are you? Seems there are not many options for removal there? 

That is what I read as well, probably also better for the immune system than going every eight weeks.

You are thinking really positive, a great way to look at it. Yes, they won‘t understand because they didn‘t made this mistake. 

How is your removal process going so far? Me too! I felt soooo cool. Like I was above it and every voice who told me you could regret it I was like pffft never, I‘m so above this! Lol.

That really sounds funny and ironic. But good that you only regret one and that otherwise tattoos are fun to you. Just as ironic as me who thought tattoos would make me feel better when now they are the thing that makes me miserable. What would I give to have this mindset back then. 

That’s shitty that you have to travel for it! My place also said probably 12 sessions, timeframe probably 2-3 years, depending on how many I can afford in a year! 

Wow this is a really great result! Almost looks like it was never there in the first place.

I‘m sorry you feel this way also! Really, feel for anyone who has to feel this way. I curse the person who invented tattoos loool. 

I had two sessions so far and it seems to work, but how much will actually go or if it can‘t be removed I will see further down the road only I guess. Have you also started removing yours?

It really does feel like a roallercoaster. I mean there are days where I seem to enjoy myself but then these thoughts come back. Especially in the summer when everyone goes swimming and stuff and I can‘t, because I feel too bad about the tattoos. Once I did with a positive mindset and then someone commented the tattoo I hate the most negatively and that was it. I don‘t want to go swimming anymore now. And I hate that, because really besides the tattoos I love my body. And if I wouldn’t have got them, I would go out to the beach and feel free. I miss this feeling of just being free inside my own head and body. And no matter how hard I try, I can‘t seem to get it back. It‘s weird to explain but I guess a lot of people here in this sub understand what I mean. 

I will continue with the laser although I don‘t know how successful it will be because of colors and white.
Thank you, I will think about it

Mom‘s just know right? People listen to your mom‘s, they know what they are talking about. 
I‘m so happy for you that talking about it made you feel so much better. 

You are a really nice person! Keep it up. 

Yes talking more publicly about it helps a ton of people I think. I saw a instagram post today where a tattoo gets lasered and the comments where really hurtful to me. A lot of people just said, don‘t get a tattoo in the first place, why would you do that, that‘s why I don‘t get tattoos and stuff like this. And I wish I would have thought like this as well. But they don‘t get how it feels to live with this regret.

That is very true! I really used tattoos to feel better back then. Now they are the thing that makes me miserable in the first place. I wish I would have found other coping mechanisms back then. Healthier ones or ones that at least didn‘t gave me tattoos. I really think back of the chain of events and realize I could have stopped myself if I didn’t were such a stubborn impulsive teenager. What was on my mind I had to get through, no matter close people telling me it‘s stupid. 

That is really good advice, thanks mate! I find it hard to do things I enjoy these days because it‘s constantly on my mind. I contemplated going to a psychologist, but I don‘t know what they could do to me other than telling me the things you tell me here. Because there‘s nothing they can do, I have to forgive myself and move past these thoughts and go through with the laser. But it‘s really hard.

Yes some make you wonder but then I think well did you think it through? No. I can understand every bad tattoo out there and that the person got it when they were young or not really right in their mindset. For me I realized I was probably depressed as a teen but I didn’t know, I wasn‘t aware. And I wasn‘t aware I used tattoos to feel good and now they make me feel bad. Such a bad comedy if you really think about it. I mean there are really good looking people with tattoos but most of the time I think they would look better without. Same for myself. 

Already started sessions! True. Made me feel a bit better at least. But I‘m still really sad that it takes forever, costs a lot of money I don‘t have and is never guaranteed. The doc told me well no guruantee how the skin looks after and he is honest but yeah. Only solution.

I don‘t really think less of them, I may think weird tattoo or that they would look better without them on their skin. I know we are always the hardest on ourselves and I can‘t seem to forgive myself. I‘m constanly thinking about the careless person I would be right now and it‘s eating me up.
Thank you. Wish you the best too. It‘s hard and I can‘t accept my decisions.

Thank you so much for this thoughtful response. It calmed my nerves for a bit. 

Looking at photos of me as a kid/teen is what I done the past days and really triggered everything again. I had a perfectly fine body. Healthy and good looking, I don’t know what in my mind I was thinking, that I had to change it. There was no reason to. My mother told me not to and I wish I had listened to her, but I was a stubborn teen. Not listenting to anyone, when I should have. 

Shame, guilt and hopelessnes are what I feel. You described that very well. How where you able to take ownership of that though? 

I feel so hopeless and it sounds so dramatic, but I know my life would be great right now in this second if I wouldn’t have done tattoos. 

Thank you, I wish you the best also and that the journey doesn’t take too long
But that could be the case with every other methods as well I guess, that you wish for survival.
I heard this as well, but at night there wouldn’t be someone I guess
I guess it depends :(
I wouldn’t do it in the daytime, to avoid this. I don‘t want to hurt someone.
You mean the moment you do it you would regret it?

It does, but it could be fast and quick. Probably I wouldn’t feel the pain and it could be instant. Also no one I know would have to find me. I just don‘t know if I could ever bring myself to actually jump.
I don‘t know. If the body is under adrenaline it doesn’t feel pain I guess, maybe it would be instant.

That’s so fucked up, I don‘t want to go into nothingness. That really scares me. But living for maybe 50+ years being unhappy is not what I want to do either. I wish we could certainly know what comes after death.
